reason: The README clearly identifies prompt enhancement and speech-to-text input as the plugin’s core user-facing functions, with optional prompt memory and DSH service restart support.

summaries.zh: 用于增强输入框中的提示词，并通过云端或本地语音识别将语音转换为草稿文本。
summaries.en: Enhances prompts in the input box and converts speech into draft text using cloud or local speech recognition.

capabilities: Rewrites draft prompts using independent LLM calls
Supports cloud and local speech recognition with microphone input
Maintains optional in-session prompt optimization memory
Provides CLI and desktop-triggered DSH service restart functionality
